input: Donate unused kitchen appliances to a charity shop

gold.taskTitle: Donate Unused Kitchen Appliances to Charity Shop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to gather unused kitchen appliances from their home and donate them to a local charity shop.

questions.title: Which specific appliances are you planning to donate?
questions.description: Identify the exact items the user wants to get rid of, such as toasters, blenders, microwaves, etc.

questions.title: How many appliances are you donating roughly?
questions.description: Understand the volume of items to determine transport and packaging needs.

questions.title: Do all the appliances still work properly?
questions.description: Establish whether items are in working condition, as many charity shops only accept functional appliances.

questions.title: Do you have a specific charity shop already in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred charity or needs help identifying a suitable one nearby.

questions.title: Do you need to arrange transport or collection?
questions.description: Determine whether the user can carry items themselves or needs a vehicle, courier, or collection service.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you want this done?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as a house move, renovation, or personal goal date.

questions.title: Are the appliances still boxed or need cleaning first?
questions.description: Understand the current condition and any preparation steps needed before donation.
